name: Permission-only hit default update retains action state
setup: $TC p4template create action/ptables/test actid 1 param param1 type bit32
$TC p4template create table/ptables/cb/tname keysz 16 table_acts act name ptables/test act name NoAction default_hit_action action ptables/test param param1 7 index 17
verifyCmd: sh -c '$TC -j p4template get table/ptables/cb/tname | python3 -c '"'"'import json,sys; before=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); after=json.load(sys.stdin); assert len(before)==len(after)==1; before[0]["default_hit"]["permissions"]="-R-D----R--X--"; assert after==before,(before,after); print("preserved")'"'"' /tmp/p4tc-defperm-$TESTID.json'
